text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Time women and men spend on unpaid care and domestic work
Average hours per day that women and men aged 15 and older spend on unpaid care and domestic work.

tspan.tspan: United Nations Statistics Division and UN Women
Unpaid care and domestic work includes: food preparation, dishwashing, upkeep of a dwelling, laundry, ironing, gardening, caring for

text.tspan: pets, shopping, servicing and repair of personal and household goods, childcare, and care of the sick, elderly or disabled household members,
among others. Where data for 2024 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2014 and 2025 is shown instead.
